text:
deploy-bot: Staged rollout kicking off for text-router -> v2.14.0. Initial window: 0->8%. Monitoring: latency, 5xx, kv-evict.

marie: got an alert — small cluster in ap-south is throwing tokenizer OOMs on long-payloads. Traffic pressure looks localized but 5xx up to ~2.4%.

todd: can reproduce with long prompt batch locally, tokenizer memory spike. Root cause likely allocator threshold with new tokenizer table.

lia: ops, can we isolate ap-south while still progressing elsewhere? I'd rather not roll back entirely if we can route around hit lane.

ops-oncall: we can pin ap-south to previous variant (v2.13.9) for safety. Command available: /deploy traffic override text-router ap-south variant=v2.13.9 --force.

marie: do the override. Also add a temporary sticky cookie so sessions are consistent.

```
/deploy traffic override text-router ap-south variant=v2.13.9 --reason "tokenizer oom regression" --sticky=true
```

deploy-bot: Override applied to ap-south. Global canary remains at 3% (paused ramp). Observability note attached. cmd_id=ov-1809991234-a

todd: after override, 5xx in ap-south back down to baseline in ~90s. No spillover to other regions.

lia: status update: hold global ramp at 3% while todd prepares a tokenizer config patch. ETA ~40m for canary-safe build and deploy.

sre-lead: agree with staged approach. Keep auto-rollback enabled but increase the detection window to 5m for this run. If anything crosses 1.5% 5xx again, we'll abort.

ops-oncall: added an incident channel and pinned runbook steps. I'll warm caches on ap-south fallback nodes to reduce cold misses.

marie: created INF-4892 with traces, failing input samples, and the rollback/override timeline. Will add release note blurb: "v2.14.0: tokenizer tuning in progress; ap-south pinned to v2.13.9 during verification."

lia: reconvene at T+30m for stop/go. If patch verified in staging, we'll resume progressive ramp: 3% -> 10% in steps.

deploy-bot: Canary paused. Region override active: ap-south -> v2.13.9. Auto-rollback: enabled (sensitivity=high), auto-promote: disabled.

marie: thanks — keeping eyes on dashboards. If any red flags before reconvene, call immediate rollback.

sre-lead: noted. If patch looks good, we may opt for a 5% intermediate step rather than jumping to 10%.
